hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .harness/progress.json ]; then PROGRESS=$(cat .harness/progress.json | tr -d "\n" | tr -d "\r" | tr -d "\t"); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"HARNESS STATE — Preserve across compaction: $PROGRESS\"}"; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -f .harness/progress.json ]; then STATUS=$(grep -o '"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' .harness/progress.json | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"'); PATTERN=$(grep -o '"pattern"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' .harness/progress.json | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"'); if [ "$STATUS" = "in_progress" ]; then echo "RESUMABLE HARNESS SESSION DETECTED (pattern: $PATTERN). Use /long-running-harness:orchestrate, /long-running-harness:iterate, or /long-running-harness:sprint to resume."; fi; fi'

hooks.prompt: The generator subagent is about to stop. Check if .harness/progress.json exists and was updated with results for the current task (look for a task entry with status 'completed' or files_modified). If progress was not updated, return BLOCK with reason 'Generator must update .harness/progress.json before stopping.' If progress was updated, return ALLOW.

The evaluator subagent is about to stop. Check the .harness/feedback/ directory for a feedback file for the current iteration. If no feedback file was written, return BLOCK with reason 'Evaluator must write feedback to .harness/feedback/ before stopping.' If a feedback file exists, return ALLOW.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .harness/progress.json ]; then STATUS=$(grep -o '"status"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' .harness/progress.json | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"'); if [ "$STATUS" = "in_progress" ]; then echo "WARNING: Harness has in-progress tasks. Progress is saved in .harness/progress.json and can be resumed next session."; fi; fi'
